children: Tyra Biosciences reported favorable initial Phase 2 SURF302 results and identified 60 mg once-daily as the potential dose for its planned registrational adjuvant strategy.
Initial safety: 60 mg QD (n=22) and 50 mg QD (n=22) showed mostly Grade 1–2 TEAEs; no Grade 4/5 events and no treatment-related Grade 3 AEs at 60 mg.
Efficacy signals: 60 mg cohort ORR 79% (11/14) at 3 months; single-lesion ORR 100% (8/8) at 3 months.
Dose decision drivers: exposure-response analysis supports 60 mg QD for adjuvant setting; TYRA will complete 60 mg enrollment and open a 70 mg cohort for ablative use.
Additional updates: first SURF303 LG UTUC patient achieved 3-month CR on 60 mg with no TEAEs; BEACH301 pediatric sentinel cohort cleared a fifth dose level with no safety signals.

title: Tyra Biosciences reports positive Phase 2 SURF302 results, 60 mg QD chosen for registrational adjuvant plan
